get.description:
Read from the persisted inventory snapshot; never calls Nautobot or
LibreNMS inline.  Query parameters: ``refresh=1`` (the board's ↻) queues an
incremental sync now, except of a source synced less than a minute ago;
``include_non_operational=1`` includes the excluded locations.
A normal request also queues a sync when one is due.

Response: ``alerts`` (one entry per site: ``alert_level``,
``alert_reason``, ``down_devices``, ``current_downtime_seconds``,
``historical_downtime_seconds``, ``active_cases``, ``latest_down_at``, ...),
``summary`` (a count per level plus ``total``, and ``non_ok`` = critical +
medium + low), ``sync_pending`` (a sync is running; poll again),
``next_update_in_seconds`` (until the next sync is due; 0 = now, null =
unknown or running) and ``persistence_configured`` (false: no database,
so the board is always empty).

get.description:

oldest source's last good sync) and ``sources`` (``name``, ``state``,
``message``, ``last_success``).

schema.title: MaintenanceCreate

post.summary: Put a site, or some of its devices, in maintenance.

get.description:
Query parameters: ``site_id`` (a row of the alert board) and
``include_non_operational=1`` (as on the board).  The devices the board
counts there: with a primary IP, not of an excluded status, and those
below the site when rows are rolled up to a location type.
get.summary: The devices that can be put in maintenance at a site.

post.description:
End or cancel several windows at once (#343): JSON ``{"ids": [1, 2, ...]}``,
at most ``maintenance.MAX_END_IDS``; ``not_found`` lists the unknown ones.
post.summary: End or cancel several windows at once: JSON ``{"ids": [1, 2, ...]}``, at most ``maintenance.MAX_END_IDS``; ``not_found`` lists the unknown ones.

get.description:
Every maintenance window that ran in a period, or was planned for it and
cancelled (#353), newest first: ``from`` and ``to`` (``2026-10-01``, both
days included; default the last 30 days; at most 366), optional ``tz``
(whose days; default UTC), ``site_id`` and ``tenant``.  Names and tenants
as ``/api/maintenance``; ``truncated`` past 5,000 windows.
get.summary: Every maintenance window that ran in a period, or was planned for it and cancelled, newest first: ``from`` and ``to`` (``2026-10-01``, both days included; default the last 30 days; at most 366), optional ``tz`` (whose days; default UTC), ``site_id`` and ``tenant``. Names and tenants as ``/api/maintenance``; ``truncated`` past 5,000 windows.

get.description:
The history as CSV (#353): the same ``from``, ``to``, ``tz``, ``site_id``
and ``tenant``; one row per window, times in UTC, streamed.  Every window,
or a 400 past 100,000: never a silently shorter file.
get.summary: The history as CSV: the same ``from``, ``to``, ``tz``, ``site_id`` and ``tenant``; one row per window, times in UTC, streamed. Every window, or a 400 past 100,000: never a silently shorter file.

get.description:
The sites maintenance can be planned for (#343), for the page's site
picker: ``id``, ``name``, ``path``, ``tenants``, ``devices`` (monitored)
and ``maintenance`` (in a window now); ``tenant_descriptions``, so the
picker finds a tenant by its description too (#497).  From the stored
board; no query per site.
get.summary: The sites maintenance can be planned for, for the page's site picker: ``id``, ``name``, ``path``, ``tenants``, ``devices`` (monitored) and ``maintenance`` (in a window now); ``tenant_descriptions``, so the picker finds a tenant by its description too. From the stored board; no query per site.

post.description: End a maintenance window now, or cancel an upcoming one (#283).
post.summary: End a maintenance window now, or cancel an upcoming one.

post.description:
Returns ``{"results": {"webhook": "ok", "email": "error: ..."}}``; errors
never include a URL or password.  400 when no channel is configured.
post.summary: Send a test message on every configured notification channel now.

get.description:
What the pages built with Nuxt read to draw themselves (#463): who is
signed in (the top bar), Nautobot's address (links to its pages), the
menu, the same as the server-rendered pages show, the Maintenance page's
and Availability's limits, the map's tiles and first view, and the
board's case links and level definitions.
get.summary: What the pages built with Nuxt read to draw themselves: who is signed in (the top bar), Nautobot's address (links to its pages), the menu, the same as the server-rendered pages show, the Maintenance page's and Availability's limits, the map's tiles and first view, and the board's case links and level definitions.

post.description:
JSON body: ``name``, ``role`` (viewer, operator or admin) and optional
``expires_in_days``.  The answer's ``token`` is the secret: shown this
once, store it now.  A status token (``role`` status, ``tenant``) also
answers ``status_link``, its tenant's page.

get.description:
Makes no Nautobot or LibreNMS calls: an upstream outage must not mark this
app unhealthy, because restarting it cannot fix the upstream.  When
persistence is configured the database must answer ``SELECT 1``, since the
alert board cannot be served without it.

Returns 200 ``{"status": "ok", "checks": {...}}`` or 503 with
``"status": "unavailable"``.  Error details are logged, never returned.
get.summary: Liveness probe for Docker, load balancers and monitoring.

post.description:
Off unless MCP_ENABLED=true.  Streamable HTTP, stateless, protocol
2026-07-28 and the older initialize-based versions.  Tools run the
matching API routes with the caller's sign-in and roles.
post.summary: MCP server for AI assistants: the alert board as tools.

get.description:
``<link_id>`` is the tenant's random link id, not its name.  Built
with Nuxt; the page reads ``/api/status/<link_id>``, with the key
from a share link's ``#key=`` (never sent to the server in the URL).
get.summary: A tenant's status page: its sites and their state, for a customer.
